import argparse

def arg_action(s):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--flag', action=getattr(argparse, s.upper()))
    args = p.parse_args([])
    return args.flag

# Bug was: `store_true` makes the flag set True; `store_false` sets False
